probe.text_sample: The American Housing Corporation Skip to main content Mission Mission Mission Careers Careers Careers Saving the American Dream Through All-Out Housing Production Through All-Out Housing Production We're using industrial manufacturing to build an abundance of beautiful starter homes in America's most dynamic cities and neighborhoods. Our Mission Our Mission Our Mission The American Rowhome Beautiful, adaptable design for American families. Image 1 of 3 Vertical Integration The American Housing Corporation is a vertically integrated real estate developer and housing manufacturer. 1 Buy Land 2 Build Homes 3 Sell Homes End-To-End Tech Building Systems We've developed a proprietary kit-of-parts for building rowhomes — designed for mass-production, low-cost shipping, and rapid on-site assembly. Factory We manufacture every major component in our own factories, using custom machines and tools engineered to automate production and ensure consistent quality. Logistics Each component of the building system is designed to fit in intermodal shipping containers, enabling low-cost shipping to any site in the country.
